payload.notes: Drew the seven measured strokes as solid black lines with line width 1.1pt and round joins, from the STYLE METRICS block. Its y comes from (257-433.57)*0.014388. Labels use the 12/14.4 pt font from the metrics, with placement chosen from each label's position relative to its vertex in the source: A and C above, G and F left, B below-left (clear of the horizontal and the diagonal), D and E below. No right-angle marks or extra edges, since the verified right-angle list is empty. Caveat: the document will not compile standalone, because the program supplies A, B, C, D, F, G at the start of the tikzpicture. Those definitions are omitted on purpose, as instructed. Remeasurement is not needed; the program-owned coordinates appear consistent with the pixel data.
